Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.web

Class WebMonitoringScheduler

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.web.WebMonitoringScheduler
@Component public class WebMonitoringScheduler extends Object
Scheduled driver for web page monitoring and HuggingFace model discovery.

Runs on a separate schedule from the RSS-based FeedHarvestScheduler to avoid Spring bean injection ambiguity and maintain clean separation of concerns between feed-based and web-scraping-based ingestion.

Scheduling cadences (configurable via application.yml):

  • Competitor pages — daily via harvestCompetitorPages()
  • HuggingFace models — daily via harvestHuggingFaceModels()

All harvested content flows into the standard ArticleStoragePort pipeline, which handles URL deduplication automatically.
